thesis: Freedom’s capacities, institutions, experience and normative value are real but distinct dimensions.

ideas.statement: Social construction does not erase effects; practical realism recognizes real constraints and revisable concepts while leaving norms open to argument.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: No single natural unit aggregates freedoms; legal reality is not legitimacy and useful stories require identifying beneficiaries and costs.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No single natural unit aggregates freedoms; legal reality is not legitimacy and useful stories require identifying beneficiaries and costs.

audit.notes: All source units read directly; thought experiments and unresolved theological issues kept conditional.
